newsitem.title: USA: Coram settles lawsuit against Caremark.
newsitem.headline: Coram settles lawsuit against Caremark.

text.p: Coram Healthcare Corp said Tuesday it had settled its lawsuit against Medpartners Inc units Caremark Inc and Caremark International Inc and, as a result, will record a one-time pre-tax gain of $165 million in the second quarter.
Coram said in a news release that Caremark will forgive $120 million in Coram promissory notes, issued in connection with Coram's acquisition of Caremark's home-infusion business.
Also, Caremark will pay Coram $45 million cash by September 1.
Coram's lawsuit sought the return of the $309 million the company paid for the Caremark business in 1995, plus interest and punitive damages. The suit alleged fraud and breach of contract.
All suits were to be dropped as a result of the settlement.
